title: Keep unrelated tree updates from rescanning the home in sigma exec
detail: When an unrelated conversation started and finished in the same home, a held sigma exec made two full conversation/list requests at e69ff71 and zero at its parent. The status watch forwards unrelated tree changes to discovery in packages/sigma/src/exec.ts:241. Discovery lists all conversations before checking ancestry at line 223. Scope discovery to descendants and preserve discovery of new workers and recovery after reconnect.
